comment: Bench ratio gate (design doc 'Bench project', S2): B1-B4 min-of-9 (plus warmup round) captured on the v5-base tag (jquery era, commit 7a9e932) with the same harness (test/bench); baseline per metric is the best of repeated captures (the code's capability, not a noisy run). B5 (heap delta) is absolute-capped. The gate fires from S2 onward (S3 exempt); bench retries absorb run noise.
harness: test/bench (min of 9 rounds after warmup; B5 = heap delta median of 5)
